_note: Registry of articles that have an image uploaded to ImageKit. Key = article id (== the uploaded filename stem), value = the file path within the ImageKit URL endpoint (ik.imagekit.io/civic/<path>). Only listed articles render an ImageKit hero/card; every other article falls back to the bundled placeholder, so unlisted ids never produce a broken image. Add an entry when an image is uploaded. A future option is to auto-populate this from the ImageKit Media Library API at build time (needs IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY).
